_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Explosive Hazard Classification Data Report (EHCDR)
summary: Specifies the content and format for a report used to obtain the information needed to assign hazard classification, storage compatibility group, and DoT marking for a new explosive item.
use_relationship:
The Explosive Hazard Classification Data Report is used to obtain the necessary information for assigning hazard classifications, such as hazard class/division, storage compatibility group, and Department of transportation (DoT) marking.  These classifications establish the procedures for the storage and transportation of the item for all user elements.

a. This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to the acquisition of any new explosive item or component which has not previously received an approved hazard classification.

b. This DID contains the content and format preparation instructions for the data products generated by MIL-STD-882, System Safety, and any specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.

c. This DID is related to DI-SAFT-80101, System Safety Hazard Analysis Report (SSHAR); DI-SAFT-80105, System Safety Program Progress Report (SSPPR); and DI-SAFT-80106, Health Hazard Assessment Report (HHAR).

(Copies of MIL-STD-882 and these DIDs are available online at http://quicksearch.dla.mil.)

d. This DID supersedes DI-SAFT-81299B.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The EHCDR shall be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The EHCDR shall contain the following:

children.title: Type of classification
children.content: Include a statement as to the type of classification being sought, either interim or final.

children.title: Hazard classification data
children.content: The data necessary for assignment of hazard classification will be supplied as shown below, using additional pages if sufficient space is not available.  The "used on" or "used with" hardwire item(s) will be identified, including their ancillary or delivery equipment.  For interim hazard classifications, some of this data may not be available, but all should be available for final hazard classifications.

children.title: Nomenclature
children.content:
(see FED-STD-5, Standard Guides for Preparation of Proposed Item Logistics Data Records.)
(Copies of this document are available online at http://quicksearch.dla.mil.)

children.title: Part number(s) and Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) number
children.content: Prime contractor and vendor(s).

children.title: System used on
children.content: System in which the subject item is associated.

children.title: Next assembly
children.content: Next higher assembly subject item is a part of.

children.title: Size
children.content: Size of unpacked item.

children.title: Weight
children.content: Weight of unpacked item.

children.title: Explosive or chemical formulation
children.content: Include type, composition, and total weight of each explosive or chemical subassembly in the item (e.g., detonator, booster, squib, rocket motor, etc.).

children.title: Weights of explosive or chemical material
Net explosive weight
children.content: Total weight of all materials that mass detonate (i.e., Class/Division 1.1).

children.title: Net propellant weight
children.content: Total weight of all propellant and pyrotechnic material (i.e., Class/Division 1.3).

children.title: Explosive weight for Quantity-Distance (Q-D) determinations
children.content: Net explosive weight, net propellant weight, or some combination of the two, according to results of testing and/or current policy for Q-D computations.  Only this weight may be used directly in Q-D computations.  Include equation used to calculate TNT equivalent weight and the reference where the equation was obtained.

children.title: Items containing a liquid or gas
Name or type of liquid or gas
Narrative
children.content: A narrative description of the item.

children.title: Functioning
children.content: Step-by-step, on how the item functions and its relation to higher assemblies.

children.title: Illustration
children.content: Illustration of the configuration of the explosive item and the relationship of the item's parts as assembled.  An illustration of the relationship of the explosive item to other items in the next higher assembly.

children.title: Number of items per inner package
Number of inner packages per outer package
United Nations (UN) identification code, Department of Transportation (DOT) Specification number
children.content:
United Nations (UN) identification code, Department of Transportation (DOT) Specification number (if packaging is exempt from UN standard packaging) (49 Code of Federal Regulations), or DoD Certification of Equivalency (COE) as applicable.
(Copies of this document are available on line at www.ecfr.gov.)

children.title: If a DOT special permit or exemption applies, give number and to what it applies
Illustration of packing and shipping containers
Limitations
children.content: Special storage or shipping limitations.

children.title: Test data
children.content: Hazard classification test data.

children.title: Responsible individual
children.content: Typed name, signature, and company of individual responsible for accuracy of the above data.

children.title: Changes in items
children.content: When hazard classification has been established for a basic item, a change in the Part Number (P/N), or change in the prefix or suffix dash number of the item will not require an additional data package, unless the change affects major configuration or explosive type and quantity.  Minor changes will be explained in a letter narrative indicating why a change in classification is not warranted.
